name: STC-208GP-Auto.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	STC-208GP-Auto
Product Name	10 port 10/100/1000Mbps Ethernet Auto-matching PoE Switch
Fixed Port	8*10/100/1000Base-TX PoE port(Data/Power) / 2*1000M SFP
PoE Ports	8*POE ports auto identifying and matching 24V/48V PD voltage / 1-8 port supports IEEE802.3af/at, max 30W/port PoE output
PoE Pin	48V: 12+ 36- / 24V: 45+ 78-
PoE Budget	Max 150W
PoE Dog	Support PoE auto detection and reset faulty device when PoE is on
Function	N: Standard normal mode / V: Port isolation mode / S: Super mode
Bandwidth	20Gbps
Packet Forwarding	14.88Mpps
MAC	4K
Buffer	2.5M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media	SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module, Max distance≤100Km
LED Indicator	P: Power LED(over-power LED) / 9-10: SFP connection indicator / PoE: 48V ON: orange light is always on / 24V ON: orange light flashes / Link: 10/100/1000M(green)
Power	Built-in power AC: 100-240VAC 50-60Hz
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-10°C～+55°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 206mm*140mm*45mm / Packing Box: 265mm*220mm*68mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	1.1Kg/1.3Kg
Lightning / Protection Level	6KV 8/20us / IP30
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty	1 Year
